# Crazy Cattle 3D - Sheep Battle Royale

> A physics-driven battle game where players control explosive sheep and cattle competing for survival across three unique environments.

Crazy Cattle 3D is a fun physics simulation game, available to play online or download, where players can experience the chaotic battles between sheep and cattle herds.

## Core Content
- [Crazy Cattle 3D Home Page](https://cattlecrazy3d.com): Home Page
- [Play Now](https://cattlecrazy3d.com/#game): Experience the complete game directly in your browser
- [Build A Ring Farm](https://cattlecrazy3d.com/build-a-ring-farm): Play a circular farm incremental game with codes, seed tips, and upgrade guide
- [Float for Brainrots](https://cattlecrazy3d.com/float-for-brainrots): Find the official playable sea Brainrot collection source with boat upgrade and shark survival tips

- [Goal Gang](https://cattlecrazy3d.com/goal-gang): Play chaotic multiplayer football with World Cup 2026 soccer tips
